notes.rarity: No published rarity figures exist yet for GTA VI: the game launched 19 November 2026 and the trackers (Exophase, PSNProfiles, TrueTrophies) have not published rarity data. Every trophy below therefore shows its grade only; no percentage has been invented.
notes.platinum: PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 in difficulty and about 200 hours to the Platinum, with one playthrough enough, no online trophies and no difficulty trophies.
notes.missable: PowerPyx and GTABase flag one trophy as potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude, because one meditation spot is only available during Chapter 1. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
notes.difficultyAndTime: Difficulty stars and time estimates are the maker's own estimates, labelled as such on every card. Story trophies show 'across the story' instead of a separate time, so the time-remaining total is not double-counted.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks automatically. It is the long game, not a hard one: PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours, with no online trophies and no difficulty setting. Follow the roadmap in order, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and finish the 100% checklist last.
trophies.tip: Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as the story begins, so it cannot be missed. Just play the opening and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.tip: Story trophy — it unlocks on its own; no preparation needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. Every chapter trophy unlocks when its final mission ends, so play the story in order and it will come to you. Before Chapter 1 ends, meditate at the Chapter 1 spot — see Positive Mental Attitude, the one missable trophy.
trophies.tip: Before Chapter 1 ends, meditate at the Chapter 1 spot — see Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Chapter trophies unlock automatically at the end of each chapter. Both protagonists become playable in Chapter 2, which opens up most of the side content, so start the stranger strands and activities once the chapter begins.
trophies.tip: Once Chapter 2 opens, start the side activities — most of the list needs both characters.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep playing the story missions in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Robbery trophies begin to open up in Chapters 3 and 4, so try one while you are passing through.
trophies.tip: Robbery trophies open up in Chapters 3 and 4 — attempt one during the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale. Before you push on to the final mission, check the Missable view — the point of no return is coming, and story moments cannot be replayed.
trophies.tip: Make a manual save before the final mission; there is no going back for story moments.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the gold story trophy and the last story beat before cleanup. Finish every missable and side trophy you care about first, because the final mission is the point of no return for story moments. Once it is done, the whole map stays open for cleanup.
trophies.tip: Do the missable check first — then finish the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock when the mission ends and cannot be missed, according to PowerPyx. Play the story in order and it pops on its own.
trophies.tip: Story mission — unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission trophy that unlocks automatically when the heist ends. Heists are story beats, so there is nothing extra to prepare.
trophies.tip: Story mission — unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Another automatic story trophy. Keep playing the missions in order and it will pop when the mission ends.
trophies.tip: Story mission — unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Automatic story trophy. No side requirement — just finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.tip: Story mission — unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic story trophy. The airport area matters again later for Catch Me If You Can, so note how VCIA is laid out while you are here.
trophies.tip: Remember VCIA's layout — you come back here for another trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic story trophy. Finishing it closes out the named-mission story trophies.
trophies.tip: Story mission — unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion using the in-game checklist. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy, but the thresholds are lenient: it is closer to 60% true completion, and most of it comes from doing the other trophies. You only need 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied, and 70 of 80 challenges. Finish the story first, then work the checklist top to bottom — it is the last trophy before the platinum.
trophies.tip: Do it last: most of the checklist fills itself in while you earn the other trophies.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses and air time while driving; they build up naturally across the whole game, so start early and keep at it between missions. Vary your driving — different stunt types all count toward the same total. The counter is a long grind, not a skill test.
trophies.tip: Start in Chapter 1 and stunt on every drive — 250 takes a whole playthrough to build.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — all 9 types. Activities are the minigames and pastimes scattered across Leonida, from the shooting range to bowling and fishing. Open the activities menu in each area and try one of each; you do not need to win or finish any of them, just try them.
trophies.tip: Trying is enough — you do not need to win any activity.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the skill trophy of the set: each challenge has a gold score threshold, so learn the range layouts and repeat them until the golds land. Take it in short sessions between story missions rather than in one sitting, and use the practice rounds to warm up first.
trophies.tip: Practice a challenge until the gold threshold feels easy, then bank it and move on.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — all 14. Each location has its own course; learn the gates on a practice run, then race to win. Short courses reward clean flying over speed, so cut corners only where you can see the next gate.
trophies.tip: Learn each course once before racing it — clean lines beat raw speed.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count, across cars, bikes and boats — variety helps, since each new race type is a fresh win. Enter races from the map as you explore, and do not repeat the same one expecting it to count twice.
trophies.tip: Each race counts once — work through 20 different ones.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge; fishing is timing, not strength, so watch the line and reel in steady bursts. Losing costs nothing — challenge him again until you win.
trophies.tip: Reel in steady bursts and watch the line tension, not the clock.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet and play one game through to its end. Any game counts, so pick the shortest one you enjoy and finish it.
trophies.tip: Pick the shortest arcade game and play it to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Stranger missions come in strands — play Andy's missions as they appear until his strand ends. The trophy pops when his last mission is done.
trophies.tip: Play a stranger's missions whenever they appear; strands end on their own schedule.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as the other stranger strands: follow Kenton's missions to their end. Keep an eye on the map for his marker between story chapters.
trophies.tip: Check the map for Kenton's marker between chapters.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission. Stranger strands are easy to miss if you rush the story, so do them as they appear.
trophies.tip: Do stranger strands as they appear — do not rush past them.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than 8 strands, so you can skip the ones you dislike. Work through them between story chapters; each strand ends with its own finale, and the trophy pops on the eighth. This is the long side-mission trophy, so start it early.
trophies.tip: Start stranger strands in Chapter 2 — there are more than 8, so skip the ones you dislike.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its end. His missions appear as you progress, so keep checking for his marker.
trophies.tip: Check for Randy's marker after each chapter.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand to its end. Like the other stranger finales, it pops when the last mission is done.
trophies.tip: Follow Tyrone's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.pointOfNoReturn: End of Chapter 1 — one meditation spot, at Jason's house, is only available during Chapter 1 (PowerPyx). There is no mission replay.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — all 18. This is the one trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as potentially missable: one meditation spot, at Jason's house, is only available during Chapter 1, and there is no mission replay. Meditate at the Chapter 1 spot before the chapter ends, then work through the other 17 spots as you explore. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as insurance.
trophies.tip: MISSABLE: meditate at the Chapter 1 spot before Chapter 1 ends — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret marks a unique animal for you — track it, get close quietly, and take the shot. Unique animals do not respawn, so make the first shot count and save before the hunt.
trophies.tip: Save before the hunt — the unique animal does not respawn.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida, and a set needs every card in it. Collect as you explore rather than hunting them all at the end — the map is huge, and three full sets is a long search. Trade duplicates if the game allows it.
trophies.tip: Collect cards as you explore — hunting three full sets at the end is a long search.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to scan unfamiliar vehicles and locations as you travel — every scan counts. Scan everything you pass instead of making special trips, and the 100 will build up across the playthrough.
trophies.tip: Scan everything you pass with WAiNK — 100 locations builds up across the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in total and you only need 50, so pick the easiest ones first. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and activities, so the total grows as you play everything else. For 100% completion you will need 70 of 80, so keep going past 50.
trophies.tip: Pick the 50 easiest of the 80 challenges — you choose which ones count.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. PowerPyx notes this unlocks automatically in Chapter 4, in the optional mission That's Where The Money Is — wait at the cafe when the mission offers it. If it does not pop there, build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear.
trophies.tip: It pops in a Chapter 4 optional mission — wait at the cafe when the mission offers it.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route past three shops, rob each in turn, and keep moving — stopping lets the wanted level catch up. Do it with your partner alongside you; the trophy needs the pair.
trophies.tip: Plan a route past three shops first, then rob them in one run without stopping.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles count when you find and scan them — drive everywhere, scan what you pass, and check new districts as they open. For 100% completion you will need 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.tip: Scan every new vehicle you see — 100% needs 200 of 277, so keep going past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait until five enemies are grouped, trigger Combat Focus, and drop them all before it ends. A busy shootout is the easiest place — let enemies gather first, then activate.
trophies.tip: Let five enemies group up first, then trigger Combat Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to the airport and leave by an unscheduled route — a runway, a service road, anywhere that is not the front door. Expect a wanted level on the way out, so have a fast vehicle ready.
trophies.tip: Have a fast vehicle ready at VCIA — expect heat on the way out.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Steal a Rhino tank — taking one raises a 3-star wanted level, so plan your escape route before you climb in. Tanks are slow, so drive it somewhere safe and let the heat die down.
trophies.tip: Plan your escape before stealing the tank — it draws a 3-star wanted level.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards, move slowly, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection fails the attempt, not the trophy.
trophies.tip: If you are spotted, leave and retry — detection fails the attempt, not the trophy.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults are the big robberies — plan each one, bring your partner if the job allows, and escape cleanly after each. Five successful escapes is the whole trophy, so take them one at a time.
trophies.tip: One vault at a time — escape cleanly after each before starting the next.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find a truck on its route, hit it, grab the cash and break away before the response arrives. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape trivial.
trophies.tip: Park a fast getaway car nearby before you hit the truck.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Visit every named area on the map; the counter ticks as new areas register. Explore district by district as the story opens them, and check the map for blank patches at the end.
trophies.tip: Explore district by district as the story opens them; check the map for blank patches.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — all 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal operations in total, but you only need one per gang. Hit one operation for each gang and the trophy pops; the rest are optional.
trophies.tip: One operation per gang is enough — 9 hits, not all 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. No detailed method has been published yet at launch, so if the first bar does not trigger it, try another spot along the beachfront.
trophies.tip: Try the beachfront bars in turn — no detailed method is published yet.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into a vehicle showroom and smash your way back out through the glass. No detailed method has been published yet at launch — pick a showroom, build speed, and go straight through.
trophies.tip: Build speed first, then go straight through the showroom glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game — follow through on every throw. Any score counts; finishing the game is what matters.
trophies.tip: Finish a full game — any score counts.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This is a partner moment — play through the story with your partner and it should unlock during a shared activity. No detailed method has been published yet at launch, so keep playing partner content as it appears.
trophies.tip: Keep playing partner content as it appears — it unlocks during a shared moment.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The game tracks your choices up to a count of 500 — every story and side decision adds to it. Play naturally, take the side missions, and say yes to choices as they come; the counter builds across the whole playthrough.
trophies.tip: Say yes to choices as they come — the counter builds across the whole game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This one is about succeeding on a second try — fail something, then succeed at it right after. No detailed method has been published yet at launch, so try a retryable activity and succeed on the second attempt.
trophies.tip: Fail a retryable activity once, then succeed on the second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — a random event out in Leonida. These events appear while you explore, so roam the wilder parts of the map and keep an eye out. No detailed method has been published yet at launch.
trophies.tip: Roam the wilder parts of Leonida — strange events find explorers.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Strike someone with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. No detailed method has been published yet at launch — find a quiet road, line up a pedestrian, and swing as you pass.
trophies.tip: Line up a slow pass on a quiet road and swing as you drive by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — launder them through your contacts a little at a time, and the total builds up. Keep robbing and laundering through the game rather than saving it all for the end.
trophies.tip: Launder marked bills little and often — the $250,000 builds up across the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Just spend — clothes, weapons, food, car parts, all of it counts. Buy what you need as you play and the total will pass $100,000 on its own; if it is short at the end, buy something big.
trophies.tip: Buy what you need as you play — the total passes $100,000 on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all 8. Garages appear for sale as you earn money; buy each one when it appears. Owning them also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect.
trophies.tip: Buy each garage as soon as it appears for sale.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, then register them in the Scooter Bros app — ten different vehicles. Use the vehicles you discover while exploring; registration is quick once you have the car.
trophies.tip: Register the vehicles you find while exploring — ten different ones.
